tagline: FemAura Bright – Herbal Intimate Brightening Oil (30 mL)
intro: A natural Ayurvedic brightening oil enriched with potent herbs and nourishing oils. It helps lighten pigmentation, hydrate delicate skin, and restore a radiant, healthy glow naturally.

p: Take 2–4 drops of FemAura Bright Oil in your hands, apply to the area, and massage gently for 3–5 minutes. Use regularly for best results.
